# dotnet-inspect

CLI tool for inspecting .NET libraries and NuGet packages.

```bash
dotnet-inspect <package>[@version]           # Package metadata
dotnet-inspect api <type> --package <pkg>    # API from package
dotnet-inspect api --platform <library>     # API from installed SDK
dotnet-inspect platform                      # List installed frameworks
dotnet-inspect find <pattern>                # Search types in runtime
dotnet-inspect extensions <type>             # Find extension methods
dotnet-inspect implements <type>             # Find implementing types
dotnet-inspect library path/to/file.dll     # Local library
dotnet-inspect diff <type> --package         # Version comparison
```

## Test Packages

| Package | Version | Scenario |
|---------|---------|----------|
| System.Text.Json | 10.0.2 | Latest, multi-TFM |
| System.Text.Json | 8.0.4 | Vulnerable (CVE-2024-43485) |
| System.Text.Json | 5.0.0 | Deprecated |
| dotnet-ef | | Tool package |
| Azure.Mcp | | RID-specific tool |

## Commands

### package

```bash
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json                    # Latest version
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json@8.0.4 -v:d         # Specific version, detailed
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json --versions -n 5    # List versions
```

### api

Supports positional arguments (no `--package` needed) and fuzzy matching for misspelled type/member names.

```bash
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json                              # List all types
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer               # Single type
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer Serialize     # Filter to member(s)
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer -m 'Deseri*'  # Glob member filter
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonArray -v:d -s:Interfaces # Interfaces only
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonArray -v:d -s:Interfaces,Baseclass  # Both
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer -s:Methods    # Methods section only
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer -s            # Header only (no sections)
dotnet-inspect api --platform System.Text.Json JsonSerializer    # Platform library
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json@9.0.0 JsonSerializer        # Specific version
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer --signatures-only  # Plain output
dotnet-inspect api 'Option<T>' --package System.CommandLine      # Generic types
dotnet-inspect api Command --package System.CommandLine --ctor   # Constructors
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer --docs        # With documentation
dotnet-inspect api 'IEnumerable<T>' --platform System.Runtime -v n  # Type parameters with constraints
```

### library

```bash
dotnet-inspect library --package System.Text.Json --tfm net8.0 --source-link-audit
```

### diff

Compare API surfaces between versions.

```bash
# All types in package
dotnet-inspect diff --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.2

# Single type
dotnet-inspect diff JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.2

# Glob filter
dotnet-inspect diff "*Writer*" --package Markout@0.1.8..0.2.0

# Platform versions (installed SDK)
dotnet-inspect diff JsonSerializer --platform System.Text.Json@8.0.23..10.0.2
dotnet-inspect diff HttpClient --platform System.Net.Http@9.0.0..10.0.0 --framework runtime
```

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--package` | Package with version range (Package@v1..v2) |
| `--platform` | Platform library with version range (Library@v1..v2) |
| `--framework` | Framework for platform diff (runtime, aspnetcore). Default: runtime |
| `--stat` | Show only statistics per type (no member details) |
| `--breaking` | Show only breaking changes |
| `--additive` | Show only additive changes |
| `--name-only` | Show only type names that changed |

### find

Search for types across packages, libraries, and frameworks.

```bash
dotnet-inspect find HttpClient                          # Search runtime (default)
dotnet-inspect find "*Stream*" -n 10                    # Glob pattern, limit results
dotnet-inspect find "*Json*" --package System.Text.Json # Search in package
dotnet-inspect find "*Serializer*" --package System.Text.Json --package Newtonsoft.Json  # Multiple packages
dotnet-inspect find "*Command*" --project ./MyApp.csproj  # Project dependencies
dotnet-inspect find "*Service*" --bin ./bin/Debug/net8.0  # Built output directory
dotnet-inspect find ILogger --framework aspnetcore      # ASP.NET Core framework
```

Batch search with multiple patterns (comma-separated):
```bash
dotnet-inspect find "Option*,Argument*,Command*" --package System.CommandLine --terse
# Output: Option*: Option, Option`1, OptionResult, ...
#         Argument*: Argument, Argument`1, ...
#         Command*: Command, RootCommand, ...

dotnet-inspect find "Option*,Argument*" --package System.CommandLine  # Table per pattern
```

Scopes can be combined:
```bash
dotnet-inspect find "ILogger" --package Microsoft.Extensions.Logging --framework aspnetcore
```

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| (none) | Defaults to `--framework runtime` |
| `--package` | NuGet package (name or name@version) |
| `--library` | Local library file |
| `--platform` | Specific platform library |
| `--framework` | All libraries in framework (runtime, aspnetcore) |
| `--project` | Project dependencies via project.assets.json |
| `--bin` | All DLLs in output directory |

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--terse` | Compact output (alias for --oneline --grouped) |
| `--oneline` | Space-separated type names on one line |
| `--name-only` | One type name per line |
| `--grouped` | Group by pattern (with --oneline) |
| `-n` | Limit results per pattern |

### extensions

Find extension methods for a type across packages and platform libraries.

```bash
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient --framework runtime        # Direct extensions
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient --framework runtime --reachable  # Include reachable types
dotnet-inspect extensions IEnumerable --framework runtime -n 20 # Limit results
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient --package Polly --framework runtime  # Multiple sources
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient --framework runtime --json # JSON output
```

The `--reachable` flag finds extensions on types accessible via properties and methods:
- `HttpClient` → `HttpResponseMessage` → `.Content` → `HttpContent`
- Shows `HttpContent` extensions with path: "Via .Send().Content"

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `--framework` | Search framework libraries (runtime, aspnetcore) |
| `--package` | Search NuGet package |
| `--library` | Search local library |
| `--platform` | Search specific platform library |

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--reachable` | Include extensions on types reachable via members |
| `--depth N` | Max depth for reachable traversal (default: 2) |
| `-n` | Limit results |

### implements

Find types that implement an interface or extend a base class.

```bash
dotnet-inspect implements IDisposable --framework runtime        # Interface implementers
dotnet-inspect implements Stream --framework runtime             # Class subclasses
dotnet-inspect implements IJsonTypeInfoResolver --package System.Text.Json  # In package
dotnet-inspect implements IEnumerable --framework runtime -n 20  # Limit results
dotnet-inspect implements IDisposable --framework runtime --json # JSON output
```

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `--framework` | Search framework libraries (runtime, aspnetcore) |
| `--package` | Search NuGet package |
| `--library` | Search local library |
| `--platform` | Search specific platform library |

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-n` | Limit results |
| `--all` | Include hidden/obsolete types |

### api --tree

Show type shape with hierarchy and members in tree format.

```bash
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json --tree     # From package
dotnet-inspect api "List\`1" --platform System.Collections --tree        # From platform
```

### platform

List installed frameworks and inspect platform libraries.

```bash
dotnet-inspect platform                            # List installed frameworks
dotnet-inspect platform --list-versions            # Installed SDK versions
dotnet-inspect platform --framework runtime        # List runtime libraries
dotnet-inspect platform --framework aspnetcore     # List ASP.NET Core libraries
dotnet-inspect api --platform System.Text.Json     # API from platform library
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --platform System.Text.Json -v:d -s:Interfaces  # With interfaces
```

### cache

Manage the dotnet-inspect cache (downloaded packages, sources, symbols).

```bash
dotnet-inspect cache                               # Show cache size breakdown
dotnet-inspect cache --clean                        # Clear the cache
```

### cli

Show CLI command structure as an API listing. Useful for discovering options.

```bash
dotnet-inspect cli                                  # All commands
dotnet-inspect cli api                              # Single command with full options
dotnet-inspect cli -v:q                             # Command names only
```

## Output

### Markdown (default)

Verbosity controls output density:

| Flag | Output |
|------|--------|
| `-v:q` | Title + compact line |
| `-v:m` | + description (default) |
| `-v:n` | + Metadata table, Type Parameters table |
| `-v:d` | + Full member signatures, Statistics, Dependencies |

For generic types, type parameters with constraints are shown:
- At `-v:q`/`-v:m`: Inline field (e.g., `**Type Parameters:** out T : allows ref struct`)
- At `-v:n`/`-v:d`: Structured table with Parameter and Constraints columns

For `api` command with `-m` filter:
- Default (`-v:m`): Summarizes overloads (e.g., "Deserialize: 40 overloads")
- Detailed (`-v:d`): Shows full signature table for each overload

The compact line summarizes key metadata:
```
Type: Library | TFM: net10.0 | Updated: 2026-01-13 | Vulnerabilities: 1
```

Section filtering:
```bash
dotnet-inspect package --discover                            # List available section names
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -v:d -x:Statistics,Files     # Exclude sections by name
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -v:d -s:Metadata             # Include only named sections
```

For `api` command, `-s` and `-x` filter by section name (e.g., Methods, Properties, Constructors):
```bash
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer -s:Methods     # Methods only
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer -x:Properties  # Exclude Properties
dotnet-inspect api System.Text.Json JsonSerializer -s              # Header only (no sections)
```

### JSON

- `--json`: Full JSON (verbosity ignored)
- `--json --compact`: Minified, nulls omitted

### Other

- `--signatures-only`: Plain method signatures (api command)

## Key Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--tfm net8.0` | Select target framework |
| `-m Name` | Filter to member |
| `--filter "Pattern*"` | Glob filter for types |
| `--ctor` | Constructor details |
| `--docs` | Fetch XML documentation |
| `--all` | Include hidden/obsolete |
| `--unsafe` | Filter to pointer methods |
| `--source-link-audit` | Source Link/determinism check |
| `--deps` | Show runtime dependencies |

## Package vs Platform

Some libraries exist in both NuGet packages and the .NET platform (installed SDK):

| Library | Package | Platform |
|----------|---------|----------|
| System.Text.Json | `--package System.Text.Json` | `--platform System.Text.Json` |
| System.Net.Http | `--package System.Net.Http` | `--platform System.Net.Http` |

**When to use each:**
- **Package**: Third-party libraries, specific versions, packages not in the SDK
- **Platform**: .NET runtime/SDK libraries, comparing SDK versions, no network needed

**Example: System.Text.Json works with both:**
```bash
# From NuGet package (downloads if needed)
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0

# From installed SDK (no download, uses local SDK)
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --platform System.Text.Json
```

**Use `find` to search across both:**
```bash
# Search platform runtime (default)
dotnet-inspect find JsonSerializer

# Search a package
dotnet-inspect find JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json

# Search both platform and package together
dotnet-inspect find JsonSerializer --framework runtime --package Newtonsoft.Json
```

The `find` command is the best starting point when you're unsure where a type lives.

## Tips

- Generic types: `'Option<T>'` or `'Option\`1'`
- Glob patterns must be quoted: `"*Stream*"` (prevents shell expansion)
- Member filter is case-insensitive
- Uses NuGet cache; `--verbose` shows cache activity

## LLM Usage Guide

### Method Signatures

Signatures include `params` and default values from metadata:
```
void .ctor(string name, params string[] aliases)
ParseResult Parse(Command command, IReadOnlyList<string> args, ParserConfiguration? configuration = null)
```

This means you can determine calling conventions directly from `api` output without additional lookups.

### Generic Type Syntax

Use C# generic syntax - the tool automatically converts to metadata format:
- `"List<T>"` → `List\`1`
- `"Dictionary<TKey, TValue>"` → `Dictionary\`2`
- `"Func<T1, T2, TResult>"` → `Func\`3`

Quote the type name to prevent shell interpretation (angle brackets or backticks).

### Command Selection

**To see interfaces a type implements:**
```bash
dotnet-inspect api "List<T>" --platform System.Collections --json
# Check "interfaces" array in output
```

**To see type hierarchy with members (tree view):**
```bash
dotnet-inspect api "List<T>" --platform System.Collections --tree
```

**To search for a type by name:**
```bash
dotnet-inspect find "*List*" --framework runtime
```

**To find extension methods for a type:**
```bash
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient --framework runtime
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient --framework runtime --reachable  # Include .Content extensions
```

**To find types implementing an interface:**
```bash
dotnet-inspect implements IDisposable --framework runtime
dotnet-inspect implements Stream --framework runtime  # Find subclasses
```

### Flag Compatibility Matrix

| Flag | api | find | extensions | implements | diff |
|------|-----|------|------------|------------|------|
| `--package` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `--platform` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `--library` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | |
| `--framework` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

### Common Library Names

| Type | Platform Library |
|------|-------------------|
| List, Dictionary, Queue | System.Collections |
| String, Int32, Object, Span | System.Runtime |
| JsonSerializer, JsonDocument | System.Text.Json |
| HttpClient, HttpRequestMessage | System.Net.Http |
| Regex, Match | System.Text.RegularExpressions |
| Task, Async | System.Threading.Tasks |
| File, Stream, Path | System.IO |

### Query Examples

```bash
# Find a type by partial name
dotnet-inspect find "*List*" --framework runtime

# Get interfaces implemented by a type
dotnet-inspect api "List<T>" --platform System.Collections -v:d -s:Interfaces

# Get full type shape with members
dotnet-inspect api "Dictionary<TKey, TValue>" --platform System.Collections --tree

# See all overloads of a method with full signatures
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -m Deserialize -v:d

# Check package for vulnerabilities
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json 8.0.0

# Compare versions
dotnet-inspect diff JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.0
```

### Discovery Workflow

When you don't know where a type lives:

```bash
# Step 1: Find the type
dotnet-inspect find "JsonSerializer" --framework runtime
# Shows: System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer in System.Text.Json.dll

# Step 2: Get overview with tree view
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --platform System.Text.Json --tree

# Step 3: Drill into specific members
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --platform System.Text.Json -m Serialize -v:d
```
